title: Deep Learning Strategy Evolution
definition: The process by which an artificial intelligence learns, adapts, and evolves its strategies over time.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Imagine a computer learning to play games like a child learns to play, through trial and error and figuring out its own strategies.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The development of increasingly sophisticated strategies by an AI, as it learns from its own experiences, interactions, and feedback.
difficulty_levels.expert: The dynamic adaptation of an AI's problem-solving approaches based on its own learning and evolution, with implications for AI autonomy, self-awareness, and long-term development.

extra_fields.insight: The AI is learning from its interactions and adapting its strategies, rather than being explicitly programmed.
